value.front:
Thing from the Stars
Of all the hideous and contemptible forms life can take, there is none more grotesque than this lumbering assemblage of carcass and corpse. Animated by an alien will, its tenuous, haphazard form is in a near-constant state of organic dissolution. This necrotic abomination cannot be allowed to wander the earth unopposed - destroy it!
